summary: Iteration 2 — Validated Criar Anúncio (social ad) module + bling_variations stock/image fixes. 9 pytest tests written; 8 pass cleanly + 1 generate end-to-end call validated manually (kept deselected on re-runs to conserve LLM credits). Found one HIGH-priority bug: ad image_url is RELATIVE because neither PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL nor REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is exported to the backend env — Meta Graph API cannot fetch a relative URL, so /api/social/ad/publish will always fail when the token IS valid. Token in DB is currently expired (FB error: 'Session has expired on 06-Jun-26'), but the publish endpoint returns a structured 200 response without crashing.

critical.issue: social_ad_service._public_asset_url() reads PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL or REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from os.environ. Neither is set in /app/backend/.env (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL only exists in /app/frontend/.env). Result: image_url returned by /ad/generate and stored on the draft is a RELATIVE path '/api/social/ad/asset/{id}.png'. Meta Graph API requires an absolute https URL to fetch the creative — publish will fail with a confusing 'invalid URL' error once Meta tokens are renewed. Fix: add PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://bling-product-robot.preview.emergentagent.com to /app/backend/.env, OR derive from the incoming Request.base_url in the FastAPI handler.

minor.issue: Instagram sub-result returns null when instagram_business_id is missing in DB, even though the user product choice was 'always post to BOTH IG + FB simultaneously'. Consider returning {ok:false, error:'IG business id não configurado'} instead of null so the UI can surface a clear reason.

Loop performs one GET /produtos/{pid} per page item (N+1) — page of 30 ≈ 30s as documented. Acceptable for MVP but consider caching descricaoCurta/marca on the parent list response or storing an 'enriched_at' flag in Mongo to short-circuit.

If Claude returns malformed JSON, fallback `parsed` uses raw product name/short — fine, but no log line is emitted. Adding await add_log('warning', 'Claude JSON parse falhou, usando fallback') would help observability.
No max-size limit; a corrupt or oversized base64 in Mongo could OOM the worker. Low risk (we control writes) but worth a sanity cap (e.g. 5MB).

rca of the issue: Relative image_url bug — RCA: social_ad_service._public_asset_url(asset_id) builds the public URL via `os.environ.get('PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL') or os.environ.get('REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL', '')`. REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is a frontend-only env var (defined in /app/frontend/.env, not /app/backend/.env). PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is undefined. Hence backend gets an empty string, .rstrip('/') yields '' and final URL becomes '/api/social/ad/asset/{id}.png'. Repro: `curl -s $URL/api/social/ad/drafts | jq '.items[0].image_url'` → '/api/social/ad/asset/...'. Mitigation: add PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL to backend/.env (no comments, no quotes), restart backend; OR change _public_asset_url to accept a Request param and use request.base_url as fallback.
